text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To improve turnout, I must expand
the range of motion in my hip joints... Ah!
Whoops!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Are you hurt, Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Such a firm hold... and yet,
supple all the way to her fingertips...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fuji-san, you are... truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, fufu... why, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Flash is so much fun☆
But your face looks like a lost little kitten!
Is something troubling you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The other day, I went to see a ballet performance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was captivated by the physical beauty that transcends normal limits...
and resolved that I, too, must acquire it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I studied numerous ballet recordings
and increased my core and flexibility training
far beyond my previous routine. However—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With only the training regimen I devised,
I feel I cannot break through...
my own limitations.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. Normally, Flash, you'd proceed
with thoroughly rational methods.
But if you want to push your flexibility beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we try training
that loosens both your mind and body
at the exact same time!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Lumping it all together
and going squishy-squish~! Like that☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
First up, Marvelous Calisthenics! Here we go~!
Ma~, Ma~, Ma~rvelo~us☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Match your face too! Ma~rvelo~us!
Smile, Flash☆
Now show those teeth—cheeeese★

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
Cheeeese...★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelo~us☆★
Yup yup, keep that smile held firm☆
All throughout training! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: W-What...?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Starting with practice swings, Flash!
Don't let your core axis waver,
and swing with a wide rotation!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Drop your hips lower!
Engage your hip joints with flexibility!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hold that posture for 100 seconds!
That completes 1 set!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Don't forget the smile~!☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Grin...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(My arms are... trembling...!
Of all things for me... I can no longer track
how many sets we have performed...!)

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It must be tough, but this is where you dig deep.
Flash, you have the potential to shine even brighter.
You can definitely transcend your limits!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! Yes...! 
I... can still keep going!

While putting away sports equipment in the gymnasium,
I noticed Eishin Flash and the others.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Flash. Let's check the results
of your training right here!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(...Supple. My joints, muscles, core...
everything is completely different from before.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(A sensation as if my body
can extend boundlessly in any direction...
This is the fruit of that training—!)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelo~us☆★☆
Flash, that's gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And what a wonderful expression on your face, too.

Compared to when she was practicing ballet poses
with Win Variation before, her movements have improved remarkably!
Impressed by her tremendous progress, I call out to her.
choice_data_list: You've improved so much! I'm genuinely amazed!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
It is all thanks to Fuji-san and Marvelous-san.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I caught a glimpse...
of the self that lies beyond my limits.
choice_data_list: Your goal lies even further ahead, doesn't it?
Your goal lies even further ahead, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I caught a glimpse...
of the self that lies beyond my limits.
choice_data_list: Your goal lies even further ahead, doesn't it?
Your goal lies even further ahead, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Precisely.
If I continue to build upon this training,
I am certain I will reach it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Toward the ideal I strive for,
I intend to march steadily forward.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Cheeeese.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I was instructed to relax my facial muscles as well.
How does it look? Am I showing visible progress?
